w.panel_off: This build has no display support
w.panel_foreign_master: Another radio is driving this bus and function registration is on, so MegaOpen stays silent and only listens rather than fight it. Turn registration off to draw over the radio.
w.panel_beside_radio: The radio drives the bus and MegaOpen draws over it (function registration is off).
w.panel_cluster_only: Only the instrument cluster is on this bus; no AFFA display
w.panel_unregistered: Registration lost: the display doesn't finish the handshake
w.media_no_panel: Display not registered, nothing to draw on
w.clock_waiting: Phone connected, no time from it yet
w.clock_no_source: No phone, and no time from the head unit
w.hu_silent: Nothing from the head unit since start-up
w.hu_seen: The head unit has sent frames; this build can't tell how recently
w.hu_dialect_vw: The head unit uses the VW canbox profile, but the board speaks Toyota RAV4. Choose Toyota RAV4 in the head unit's car settings.
w.knobs_no_expander: PCF8574 not found: check the QWIIC 2 cable and the adapter's power

h.canNone: No frames: the bus is asleep or not connected

e.form_temp: 0x28 carries the outside temperature now: switch it in Service › Raise
k.raise.prnd: Gear selector P R N D (trial)
k.raise.batt_v.why: protocol 112 has no field of its own; another can carry it: «From» → another signal, batt_v ÷10, on range, average consumption or tank %
k.set.pulseMs: Key press length to the head unit, ms
k.set.logWeb: Log on the page up to
k.set.logSerial: Log to USB serial up to
k.set.raise.doorsLen: Doors: frame length (with 1 the app sees the bonnet open)
k.con.confirm.caption: button
k.con.notify.title: title
sc.srcAuto: Auto: the head unit while it sends text (15 s of silence counts as none), otherwise the iPhone.
sc.srcNoBle: Bluetooth is off, so only the head unit over UART.
sc.carShowH: Three rows of car data across the whole display.
sc.carWhatH: Trip: consumption now / average, range, trip distance; “--” means no data.
sc.carHint: The rows below apply with “My rows”.
sc.autoTimeH: From the head unit over UART (0x9D, every minute){0}.
sc.funcRegH: On: the board does the handshake with the display itself (no stock radio). Off: the stock radio does the handshake and the board only supplies the text.
bd.ble.off: Bluetooth stays off, which frees 40 kB of memory. Music and time come from the head unit over UART.
bd.ble.ams: AMS: track title and player control. ANCS: notifications. CTS: clock. iPhone only, one at a time.
bd.ble.keyboard: The board becomes a Bluetooth remote: play, next, previous, volume. For Android or a head unit without AMS. No text.
bd.ble.both: An iPhone (AMS, ANCS, CTS) and an HID remote for a second device, both at once.
bd.apH: Starts by itself when no network connects within 15 s or the link drops for 30 s. Retries the networks every 60 s while nobody is connected to the hotspot.
bd.wifiAutoH: WiFi goes off once MegaOpen Companion has been on USB for 10 s (the page, alerts, updates and logs then go through it) and comes back 30 s after the app is gone.
bd.forgetAsk: Forget all pairings? On the iPhone too: Bluetooth → MEGA → Forget This Device.
bd.ghH: The latest stable release from github.com/Barbedx/MegaOpen. Only with internet, only from this button, and never while driving. The image is checked against SHA-256; if the new firmware isn't healthy within 3 minutes, the board goes back to the previous one.
bd.logLevelH: What to write: ERR only errors, WRN and warnings, INF state changes (usual), DBG every action (a key, a frame from the head unit), TRC everything. Saved.
bd.logFlashH: Flash takes at most DBG: TRC would erase sectors for every frame.
bd.logTagsH: A level of its own for one tag, e.g. hu=TRC while the rest is INF. The tags are those the board has written since it started.
bd.logTagsNone: Every tag at the global level
bd.logH: The same lines as the serial port, kept in flash: one file per boot, the last 8. The live stream is in Service › Log. After a hang or a power cut the last ~16 kB may be missing.
bd.toFileH: All settings, the knobs and the CAN map (with the ✓ checks) to a .json file; from a file after you review the changes. Wi-Fi passwords stay out of the file.
bd.allH: The same values as the display menu (hold the right knob).
bd.ghAsk: Download {0} from GitHub? The restart comes later, separately.
bd.factoryAsk: Erase everything, Wi-Fi included. The board will start its hotspot at 192.168.4.1.
bd.otherFwH: keys this one doesn't know are skipped
bd.skipped: Skipped: this board doesn't have that part
bd.appliedH: some of it after a restart
bd.gh.writtenW: SHA-256 matched · restarts by itself when the car is parked, or with the button
bd.gh.queuedW: the log is finishing a part on GitHub; this starts by itself right after it
bd.bt.visible: visible as MEGA: iPhone → Settings → Bluetooth
sv.sweepH: Sends rulers to the display step by step (docs/glass-sweeps.md). At each step photograph the glass and note the last character you can see. The digit or letter every 10 characters counts the tens.
sv.sw.1: Full screen, digits: the last visible character
sv.sw.2: Full screen, W (the widest): the last visible one
sv.sw.3: Full screen, lower case: the last visible one
sv.sw.4: Three rows of 22: are all three whole (each ends in B12)
sv.sw.5: Menu: header, a row of digits, a row of W: the last visible ones
sv.sw.6: Info: 8 characters in each row; how much room is left on the right of the frame
sv.wireH: Sends a key frame onto the display bus as if from the stalk, to test the stock radio. The board doesn't act on it itself.
sv.testH: Puts in a made-up track so you can see the layout without a phone. It stays until the source updates the screen.
sv.title: Title
sv.huH: When the head unit sends text without a marker, the board learns: the first command with text is the title, the second the artist. You can pin them by hand.
sv.forgetAsk: Forget the learned head unit text commands?
sv.eccH: The TWAI controller's ECC register: 3000 samples of which errors occur (bit, form, stuff) and where in the frame. Helps find a bad solder joint or terminator.
sv.capRing: When storage is full, overwrite the oldest
kb.why.no_ams_role: The Bluetooth role has no iPhone
kb.why.no_hid_role: The Bluetooth role has no keyboard (HID)
kb.code: Head unit code; empty means the default
kb.testKey: Same as pressing it on the wheel: goes the same routes
kb.testH: A lamp flashes on every change of its line, however short. The numbers count the changes: each click adds 2 to A and to B. If a number grows while you wiggle a wire without turning, that's a bad contact. Only one of A/B grows: the other is broken. Nothing grows: no ground or no +. “sound” clicks on every change.
kb.name: Name
kb.lastH: Press a key on the wheel: its row lights up (blue for a click, yellow for a hold). The wrong row lights up: the stalk wires are swapped. ▶ does the same as a press: the action goes the routes below.
kb.pressWheel: press a key on the wheel
kb.pulse: Key press length to the head unit, ms
kb.popup: Show key presses on the display, ms
kb.ringRevH: The effect runs the other way from the knob: the ring's LEDs are soldered anticlockwise. This mirrors every ring.
kb.resetAsk: Reset all {0} assignments to the defaults?
kb.macDefAsk: Replace all macros with the examples?
kb.noCode: — that code isn't in the table
kb.fallbackH: The head unit is silent, so volume goes to the phone
dr.encH: The bytes the head unit gets per wheel click. The defaults are RAV4 TUNE+ / TUNE−.
dr.defAsk: Reset the matrix to the Megane layout?
dr.learnT: Hold the rung for 4 s so the head unit learns it
dr.ctrlH: GPIO drives the line itself; MOSFET: the GPIO switches a transistor (HIGH = pressed).
dr.sepH: How close the two nearest rungs the head unit must tell apart are. Under about 15 % it may confuse them.
dr.learning: holding for 4 s, the head unit is learning
ca.quick: door open|door shut|headlights|side lights|indicator L|indicator R|reverse|brake|A/C|fuel
ca.unlockT: Now kept when storage runs out. Press to allow deleting it.
e.field_off: the field is off: switch it on under «From» (its own signal or another)
ca.ownEdit: change it in the signals table
lv.bindT: Where this signal comes from: a CAN row, a constant or nothing
ca.protoSub: what the board speaks to the head unit; the fields below are its
bd.picFileH: the panel picture from the file replaces the one on the board
ca.calcT: The board fills this HU field itself: it computes the value (from speed, rpm, fuel use) and sends it over the UART with the rest. Tap to take the value from a car CAN ID or a constant instead; «board → HU» in the list brings the computation back.
ca.sendT: Send to the head unit now and hold for 30 s
ca.gearsH: The board takes the gear from speed over rpm (km/h per 1000 rpm x10) and this table; clutch pressed, neutral or a crawl is N. To calibrate: drive steadily in a gear with the clutch up and press «This is N»: the current ratio goes into the table. «Learned» is what the board collected near that value this drive.
ca.gNoPeaks: No steady ratio collected yet (about 5 s of steady driving in a gear)
ca.gNoRatio: No ratio: the car has to be moving
ca.pushMoved: What goes to GitHub (the log, the CAN recording, the daily limit) is one card on the Board page.
ca.mapSub: where a signal comes from (CAN, constant), what the head unit gets, alerts on the display
ca.speedH: Auto: the last good one first, then 500 → 250 → 125 → 1000k. Once found it's kept until a restart. The board only listens.
ca.autostartH: Recording starts as soon as frames appear after start-up.
ca.filesH: When storage runs out, the oldest files are deleted by themselves. 🔒 keeps a file. A marker puts 🔒 on its session.
ca.send: Send car data to the head unit
ca.sendH: On the left: what the RAV4 protocol can carry (0x2E …). ▶ sends a test value to the head unit at once and holds it for 30 s, so you see what Android shows and where. Then “bind” the field to a car ID. A grey row is a value protocol 112 has no field for: “experiment ↓” shows it in another head unit field.
ca.sweepH: Sends 0x7D 06 to the head unit with D2 = 0, 1 … 15, one value per step. Watch the tablet: when P, R, N or D appears, note the D2 number. Needs the selector field in the table below switched on: «From» → its own signal. Each value holds for 30 s; after the sweep stops the frame goes away by itself.
ca.huH: “from the head unit”: only its frames (track text, clock, requests). “everything”: ours too, which go every 200 ms.
ca.idTableH: Counts frames per ID and highlights the bytes that changed since the baseline.
ca.needSel: switch the selector field on first: «From» → its own signal
ca.resetAsk: Restore the factory bindings? Your changes will be lost.
ca.doIt: Do the thing in the car (open a door, turn on the lights…), then press again.
lv.confOn: Confirm: the signal is checked in the car, and its “?” goes everywhere (menu, car screen, G-meter). “Factory bindings” makes it a hypothesis again.
lv.confOff: Undo the confirmation: the signal is a hypothesis again, with its “?”.
map.title: Map
lv.autoSub: every 2 s while the page is open
lv.alH: When the condition holds, the name and value pop up on the display, but never over the menu: they wait for it to close and go if the condition has passed. “appeared” for yes/no is the moment it turns on. Pause: not more often than once in that many seconds. 🔔 in the table above adds a signal here.
lv.uncheckedT: not checked in the car yet
lv.undoT: confirmed here; make it a hypothesis again
lv.noValues: no values: is CAN A silent?
e.gh_host: Only GitHub over https is allowed
e.gh_connect: Can't connect: no internet, or TLS failed
e.gh_rate: GitHub limits checks (60 an hour per address): try later
e.gh_none: No published release on GitHub yet
e.gh_no_tag: The latest release has no version tag
e.gh_draft: The latest release is a draft or a pre-release
e.gh_no_asset: The latest release has no image for this board
e.gh_no_sums: The latest release has no SHA256SUMS
e.gh_no_sum_line: SHA256SUMS has no line for the image
e.gh_size: The image size doesn't match the release
e.gh_slot: The image doesn't fit the OTA slot
e.gh_broke: The download broke off at {0} of {1} bytes
e.gh_sha: SHA-256 didn't match: nothing was changed
e.cap_full_noring: Storage is full and overwriting the oldest is off
e.cap_full: Storage is full and there's nothing left to delete
e.cap_write: A write came up short: is storage full?
bd.pushH: While the board is on a network with internet (e.g. the head unit's hotspot), it puts the new log lines into a private GitHub repository as a file once a minute. Without internet the lines wait in PSRAM (~1 MB, about an hour and a half) and go once the link is back.
bd.pushTokH: Fine-grained token: access to this repository only, Contents: Read and write. The board never shows it.
e.tls_busy: Another download from the internet did not finish within a minute; try again
e.push_token: GitHub refused the token (401): wrong or expired
e.push_denied: GitHub said 403: the token lacks Contents: write, or the rate limit
e.push_repo: Repository not found (404), or the token has no access to it
e.push_conflict: Write conflict in the repository (409), retrying later
e.push_exists: That file already exists (422), taking the next number
e.push_net: Cannot reach GitHub: no internet, or TLS
e.push_heap: Low on free memory, push postponed
e.push_token_bad: A token is Latin letters, digits and _, 20–255 characters
bd.pushCanH: The board records the car bus (frame changes) and puts each closed recording file into the same repository in 512 kB parts: <device>/cap/. Switching it on starts recording; nothing recorded before is sent.
e.push_can_mb: The daily limit is 1 to 5000 MB
bd.ghPreH: On: «Check» takes the newest version on GitHub, test builds (rc) included, before they become stable. Off: stable only. The 3 min rollback works the same.
bd.mapFileH: The file carries the CAN table (bindings, the ✓ checks) and what the board sends to the head unit: they replace the current ones.
ca.diagH: The board sends one request to the climate ECU on the car bus (21 C1 to 0x744) and reads the reply: cabin temperature and sun. No diagnostic session is opened, nothing is written. Only while the bus is alive; any bus error puts it back to listen-only and switches it off.
ca.diagSweepH: One pass, ~25 s, engine running: the reads 21 80, C0, C1, C2, 90 (the driver's setpoint?), A0 without a session; 10 C0; the same reads in it with 3E between; 10 81 (back, always). Every reply word for word (7F 21 12, "not supported", is a result too) and the bus around it (frames and ids a second) go to the log, lines [diag] sweep. Watch the cluster: if it reboots, the log shows it too (ids go missing).
ca.diagSweepAsk: Send 10 C0 (a diagnostic session) to the climate ECU? Opening one once rebooted the cluster.
ca.diagSesH: Open the climate ECU's extended session before polling (10 C0, as DDT4all does), keep it with 3E every 2 s, close it with 10 81 when switched off. Refused: polling goes on without. Off by default.
ca.diagSent: request sent, the reply is in the [diag] log
